name: Gomi no Machi wa Amamoyou
source:
You awoke to find yourself in a town littered with trash, in which you meet a boy named Wakaba and a creature named Lee. Having lost your memory, you set out with the two to recover it.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12938]Novelgame[/url]]
